text:
jen_partnerships: Heads-up 0min sync: VaultStream (SI) wants to push a joint listing in the MSSP marketplace that bundles Redwood Private + their secrets manager. Core asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM key-wrap demo. Partner wants a short integration runbook + smoke script by EOW for their webinar. @samir_eng @lee_security can we commit?

samir_eng: I can own the smoke tests. Need to confirm KMS scope 1) key-wrap (symmetric) for secret rotation or 2) HSM-signing workflows?

jen_partnerships: They primarily mentioned key-wrap for rotating secrets-at-rest (wrap/unwrap). Also request sample SAML assertions and a SCIM sync example. Deadline is tight 1wk webinar.

lee_security: We'll treat this as customer-managed KMS for Redwood Private (BYOK). Need to know VaultStream's KMS vendor (they called out KeyWave) and whether it speaks KMIP. Also want a short threat-model note about cross-tenant key access and KMS credentials.

samir_eng: Ops has a KMIP emulator image we can use in staging. I'll stand up a Private staging node in the partner VPC and run through KMIP key wrap. Any CI harness for KMIP?

jen_partnerships: no public harness; ops will hand over the emulator. Olivia: are they supplying a dev tenant?

olivia_sales: Yes — VaultStream will provide a dev account + a non-prod KMIP endpoint (test certs). They asked for an integration checklist so they can prep keys, roles, and service accounts.

samir_eng: Plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) SCIM token + group sync example, 3) KMIP key-wrap handshake test, 4) call Redwood rotate API to verify wrapped secret rotates. I'll post commands and a tiny script.

samir_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.vaultstream.example/scim/token \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"client_id":"vaultstream-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

lee_security: For SAML demo use signed assertions and a sanitized IdP metadata snapshot. Do not embed real certs in the runbook. Add note: avoid long-lived provisioning tokens and document token lifecycle.

jen_partnerships: marketing wants a one-page "how it works" + a short slide deck. Maria can own copy if eng gives assets.

maria_pm: I can draft the 1-pager and 4-slide deck. Need sample commands, a short sequence diagram, and 2 screenshots by Wed.

samir_eng: I'll aim for smoke logs + a bash script by Tue EOD. Example rotate call (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"vs-demo-secret","kms_key_id":"kmip://test-key"}'
```

deploy-bot: CI: vaultstream-integ smoke run finished  8 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM paging). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/1234 :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: SCIM timeout caused by large page size on VaultStream staging. Switching to incremental sync with backoff and idempotency. I'll update the script.

lee_security: Add an idempotency header for provisioning calls to prevent duplicates. Also include rollback: if rotation fails, revert to previous wrap key and mark secrets read-only until manual review.

jen_partnerships: Action list: Samir  E2E smoke + scripts (Tue EOD); Maria  runbook + slides (Wed EOD); Olivia  partner dev tenant & test certs (Wed AM); Lee  security blurb + short threat-model (Wed EOD). Marketing needs final assets Thu for joint comms.

olivia_sales: I'll prod VaultStream for certs and service account details today.

maria_pm: Scheduled a rehearsal Thurs 10am with VaultStream product + marketing  invite sent.

samir_eng: Temporary repo with scripts: https://git.internal/redwood/vaultstream-integ (internal). Will sanitize before sharing externally.

lee_security: Reminder: runbook must use placeholders for certs/keys and include CA thumbprint validation steps for KMIP endpoints.

jen_partnerships: Great. We'll consolidate and share the runbook draft by Wed. Thanks team :rocket:
